pages.text: A detector rail whose signal strength depends on the cart on it, to sort carts with comparators or dust.

**Signals:**
Minecart, empty carriage: 1
Carriage with a rider: 2
Hopper minecart: 3
Chest or furnace minecart: 6
Locomotive: 9
Ender minecart: 12
TNT minecart: 15
Freight cart: 1 (empty) to 15 (full)
Other carts: 0

Add carts from other mods with the entity type tags xincraft:inspector_rail_signal/1 to /15.

Like a detector rail it strongly powers the block below, powers powered rails beside it, and holds its signal a second after the cart leaves.
